meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Bharat ki skin tones aur climate ko dekhte hue, aise sunscreens chunna bahut zaroori hai jo lightweight hon aur bilkul bhi **white cast** na chhodein.

Aapke liye kuch best aur highly-rated sunscreens ki list yeh rahi, jo Indian skin par bina white cast ke achhi tarah blend ho jaate hain:

---

### ## 1. Budget-Friendly & Best for Daily Use

* **Derma Co. 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel (SPF 50 PA++++)**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Yeh gel-based sunscreen hai jo skin mein ekdum paani ki tarah ghul jata hai. Isme hyaluronic acid hai jo skin ko hydrate rakhta hai aur yeh bilkul white cast nahi chhodta.
  * **Skin Type:** Normal se Dry skin ke liye best.
* **Aqualogica Glow+ Dewy Sunscreen (SPF 50+ PA++++)**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Water-light texture hai, lagane ke baad skin par ek natural dew/glow aata hai aur heavy bilkul nahi lagta.
  * **Skin Type:** Sabhi skin types ke liye, khaaskar dull skin ke liye.

---

### ## 2. Best for Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

* **Minimalist Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Yeh ek clinical formulation hai jo matte finish deti hai. Yeh sweat-resistant hai aur isme koi white cast nahi hoti. Fragrance-free bhi hai.
  * **Skin Type:** Oily aur Sensitive skin ke liye behtareen.
* **Fixderma Shadow SPF 50+ Gel**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Dermatologists dwara kafi recommend kiya jata hai. Non-greasy gel formula hai jo turant skin mein absorb ho jata hai.
  * **Skin Type:** Oily aur Acne-prone skin.

---

### ## 3. Premium & Invisible Finish Options

* **ISNTREE Hyaluronic Acid Watery Sun Gel SPF 50+ PA++++ (K-Beauty)**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Agar budget thoda zyada hai, toh yeh K-beauty sunscreen sabse best mana jata hai. Yeh skin par bilkul invisible rehta hai aur moisturizer ki tarah kaam karta hai.
  * **Skin Type:** Sabhi skin types (Dry se Combination).
* **Foxtale Matte Finish Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Velvet matte finish deta hai, pore-blurring effect hai aur sun protection ke sath skin ko soft banata hai.

---

> **Tip:** Sunscreen hamesha ghar se nikalne ya dhoop mein jaane se **15–20 minutes pehle** lagayein, aur agar aap bahar hain toh har **3 se 4 ghante baad** ise re-apply zaroor karein.

Aapki skin type (jaise oily, dry, ya sensitive) kya hai, uske hisaab se aap inme se koi bhi chun sakte hain.
